trigger_condition: carry-over insert_budget_entries raises; session holds uncommitted upsert+activity writes
guard_snippet: use db savepoint: async with session.begin_nested(): ... instead of bare session.rollback()
potential_consequence: budget assignment (upsert + activity event) silently rolled back; caller sees success

trigger_condition: multi-category assignments; carry-over fails for category A; loop continues to B
guard_snippet: wrap each category's assignment+carry-over in a nested savepoint so rollback is scoped per category
potential_consequence: category A assignment permanently lost; remaining categories proceed; inconsistent state undetected

trigger_condition: _persist_bulk_budget_assignments writes uncommitted; any carry-over insert fails → rollback
guard_snippet: run _record_bulk_assignment_carry_over inside a nested savepoint scope after bulk assignments commit
potential_consequence: entire bulk assignment batch for all users rolled back silently on first carry-over failure

trigger_condition: prev_row is None or quantized spend is zero; marker list is empty
potential_consequence: unnecessary DB round-trip issued for every no-op category or user

trigger_condition: prev_row.budget_period_spend is NULL in DB; Decimal constructor raises TypeError
guard_snippet: add guard: prev_row.budget_period_spend is not None before calling _quantize_spend
potential_consequence: TypeError caught by except handler triggers session.rollback(), silently losing the assignment

trigger_condition: N users with M assigned categories; each (user, budget_id) pair issues a separate DB query
guard_snippet: collect all non-None budget_ids for a user, call get_latest_by_budget_ids(session, all_ids, username) once per user
potential_consequence: O(N*M) queries instead of O(N); degrades under large bulk assignment batches
